name: Attunement
says: no SRD text for the general rule in the repository (magic-items.json holds item entries only); an item that requires attunement gives its properties only while the creature is attuned to it; 175 entries say 'requires attunement' in their first line.
does: Attuned gates only the +N gear bonus (rules/itembonus.go); SpendItemCharges (characters/itemchargeskeeper.go) spends a charge of an item that requires attunement while it is not attuned, and the screen says nothing. The master can give the charge back by hand.
seen: Pill 'Pede sintonização' or 'Sintonizado' on each magic item row, a 'Sintonização' section with the reason line; nothing stops or warns a charge use while unattuned.
code: rules/attunement.go AttunedCount; rules/itembonus.go counts; characters/attunement.go fillMagicItems; characters/itemchargeskeeper.go SpendItemCharges (no attuned test); web equipment-panel.ts pill
fix: In SpendItemCharges (and the Usar sheet) refuse or warn when the entry requires attunement and is not attuned.

name: Attunement takes a short rest
says: no SRD text for the general rule in the repository (magic-items.json holds item entries only); attuning takes a short rest spent focusing on the item.
does: RN-02 (Attunement): a short or long rest opens one window per character; in it the owner attunes one item or ends one, and the window closes; the master attunes or ends at any time; a dead character's owner has no window.
seen: Section lead lines: 'Neste descanso você pode sintonizar ou encerrar um item', 'A sintonização deste descanso foi usada. A próxima abre no próximo descanso'; the 'Mudar' button follows the window.
code: characters/rests.go restEveryone (SetAttunementOpen); characters/attunement.go checkAttunement, writeAttunement; web attunement-rows.ts leadOf

name: Limit of three attuned items
says: A creature can be attuned to at most three magic items at once (SRD 5.1 attunement; the same limit is in docs RN-02).
does: A fourth attunement is refused to the owner and to the master alike (ATTUNEMENT_LIMIT); the count adds attuned catalog items and attuned +N pieces that require it; ending one is never refused for the limit.
seen: 'Limite de 3 itens.' line with the count and the row button dashed.
code: rules/attunement.go MaxAttunements, AttunedCount; characters/attunement.go checkAttunement

name: Attunement restricted by class, alignment or race
says: 29 items say 'requires attunement by a class, a spellcaster, a dwarf, a creature of good or evil alignment' or 'outdoors at night'; the creature must meet it.
does: Class lists, spellcaster (Derived.Spellcasting not empty), dwarf (Build.Race), good/evil (the sheet alignment; unset means only the master decides) are checked and refuse the owner; 'outdoors at night' (Ring of Shooting Stars) is always met and only shown; the master may attune anyway (RN-02).
seen: Reason line such as 'Só para um paladino: ...' with 'Como mestre, você pode sintonizar mesmo assim', 'Só ao ar livre, à noite'; the picker card shows the same tag.
code: rules/attunement.go parseAttunementRule, meets, AttunementOf; characters/attunement.go checkAttunement; web attunement-rows.ts reasonOf

name: Attunement ends
says: no SRD text for the general rule in the repository (magic-items.json holds item entries only); attunement ends when the creature no longer meets the requirement, is 100 feet from the item for 24 hours, dies, another creature attunes, or by a short rest.
does: RN-02: the app never ends an attunement by itself (distance, another attuner, death, losing the requirement); the owner ends it in a rest window, the master by hand; a character that dies stays attuned.
seen: 'Encerrar' button on an attuned row; no automatic notice.
code: characters/attunement.go attuneIn, checkAttunement

name: Wearing limits (two rings, one cloak, one of each kind)
says: no SRD text for the general rule in the repository (magic-items.json holds item entries only); a creature wears at most two rings, one pair of boots, one cloak and so on, and gains the benefit of one of each kind.
does: A magic item entry has no worn or equipped state and no kind count: any mix of up to 20 entries (MaxMagicItems) is accepted, three rings included.
seen: nothing
code: rules/attunement.go MaxMagicItems, checkMagicItems; rules/api.go SheetMagicItem (Key, Attuned, ID only)
fix: A reminder under the 'Itens mágicos' list ('duas alianças, uma capa, um par de botas'), or a worn flag with a per-kind count.

name: Activating an item (command word, action, wearing)
says: Each item's text says how its property starts: a command word, an action, a bonus action, a reaction, or simply wearing it.
does: Nothing is activated: Usar on a charged item only subtracts charges (no action spent even in a combat, no command word, no attunement test), and a consumable other than a potion is spent with no turn. The item's text is never shown to a player: only the master's treasure page (GetMagicItem, master only) and the UseConsumable reply (no screen calls it) carry it.
seen: Use sheet note 'Quanto cada uso gasta está no texto do item' but no screen shows that text to the player.
code: play/charges.go spendChargesTx; maps/treasure.go GetMagicItem (requireDungeonMaster); web use-charges-sheet.ts
fix: Open the item's text (rules.MagicItem Desc/DescPT) from the sheet row, like 'Ver descrição' on the treasure page.

name: Spell cast from an item
says: A spell cast from an item uses the item's own save DC and attack bonus (or the wearer's, as the text says), needs no material components unless stated, and uses no spell slot of the wearer.
does: Never cast: Usar only spends charges; nothing links an item to a spell (item_charges.json has numbers only), and the proto field SheetMagicItem.spell_key is never filled by the server.
seen: nothing beyond the charge count
code: backend/internal/rules/srd51/effects/item_charges.json; characters.proto SheetMagicItem.spell_key (no Go writer); play/charges.go spendChargesTx
fix: Put the spell and its DC in the use sheet's note from the item's catalog text; a cast that spends no slot needs the granted-spell path (RN-23) pointed at an item.

name: Charges
says: A wand, staff, ring or other item holds a fixed number of charges and expends them as its text says.
does: 51 items (item_charges.json, every item whose text says 'charges') get a maximum, a spend of 1 to left, refusals when empty or lost, a log line and the master's correction; Luck Blade and Nine Lives Stealer start unset until the master rolls the count (RN-02). What each use costs and does stays with the table.
seen: '3 de 7 cargas' row with pips, 'Usar' sheet, 'Sem cargas...' refusals, party panel for the master.
code: rules/itemcharges.go loadItemCharges; characters/itemchargeskeeper.go SpendItemCharges; play/charges.go SpendCharges; web equipment-panel.html, use-charges-sheet.ts

name: Recharge at dawn
says: An item regains expended charges at dawn, by dice or all of them, never past its maximum; the ivory goats regain all 7 days after the last charge.
does: The master's 'Amanhecer' (or a long rest asked with restoreDawn) rolls each item's dice with the app's dice, caps at the maximum, skips a lost item, one waiting for its d20 and one that never recharges; a short rest never recharges (RN-02).
seen: 'Volta 1d6 + 1 ao amanhecer', 'Não volta: cada carga gasta se vai.', the dawn history.
code: characters/dawn.go stepDawn, RestoreDawn; rules/itemcharges.go; web recharge-text.ts

name: Roll when the last charge is spent
says: Staffs and wands: when the last charge is spent roll a d20; on a 1 the item is lost as its text says (destroyed, becomes nonmagical, keeps only its bonus), on a 20 some items regain charges (Staff of Power 1d8+2, Staff of the Magi 1d12+1).
does: The spend that empties an item sets the pending roll; RollLastCharge rolls the d20 (or takes the typed face) and the regain die; a 1 applies the catalog loss (gone, plain, partly), a 20 regains the dice; items that lose themselves at once (Scarab, Talismans, Ring of Three Wishes, Gem of Brightness) do it on the spend. Numbers match the 51 texts.
seen: 'Rolar a última carga' sheet, lost tags 'Destruída' or 'Sem magia', log line.
code: characters/itemchargeskeeper.go SpendItemCharges, ResolveLastCharge; play/charges.go rollLastChargeTx, rollTheLastCharge; rules/itemcharges.go checkChargesLoss

says: About 40 items give a property usable once or a few times per day or 'until the next dawn' with no charges (Luck Blade reroll, Dragon Scale Mail breath, Bag of Tricks, Rod of Rulership, Necklace of Prayer Beads, Cloak of the Bat...).
does: Not tracked: only items whose text says 'charges' are in item_charges.json; a once-per-day property has no counter, no dawn reset and no log line.

fix: Add an item_charges.json entry per item (max N, recharge dawn, regain all, empty none): the loader already supports it.

name: Identifying an item

A catalog magic weapon without a +N (Flame Tongue, Vorpal Sword) is an unlinked magic item entry, so its sheet weapon stays nonmagical until the table marks it; unmarked counts as nonmagical (RN-02). Magic armor never matters here.
